home.heading: Build better habits.
home.subheading: Foundation build — product features arrive in later phases.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

overview.emptyDescription: Today's habits, tasks, focus time and progress will be summarised here.

habits.emptyDescription: Habits you create, with their schedules, streaks and history, will appear here.

goals.emptyDescription: Goals with milestones and measurable progress will appear here.

tasks.emptyDescription: Tasks with subtasks, priorities and due dates will appear here, in list, calendar and board views.

planner.emptyDescription: Plan your day and week, and prioritise with the Eisenhower matrix, here.

focus.emptyDescription: Focus timers and your session history will appear here.

journal.emptyDescription: Daily reflections and notes will appear here. Your journal stays private.

insights.emptyDescription: Trends, weekly reviews and experiments based on your activity will appear here.

coach.emptyTitle: The AI coach isn't available yet
coach.emptyDescription: Personal suggestions based on your progress will appear here. It never changes your data without your confirmation.

settings.emptyDescription: Profile, preferences, notifications, privacy, billing, integrations and accountability settings will live here.

apiErrors.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be processed.
apiErrors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information you entered is not valid. Check it and try again.
apiErrors.INVALID_CURSOR: This list has changed. Reload it and try again.
apiErrors.MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY: The request could not be read. Try again.
apiErrors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
apiErrors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
apiErrors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.
apiErrors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
apiErrors.CSRF_FAILED: This request couldn't be verified. Reload the page and try again.
apiErrors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address to use this feature.
apiErrors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
apiErrors.CONFLICT: This was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload and try again.
apiErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. {seconds, plural, =0 {Try again in a moment.} one {Try again in # second.} other {Try again in # seconds.}}
apiErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.NOT_READY: The service is starting up. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: Background processing is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.NETWORK_ERROR: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
apiErrors.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
apiErrors.INVALID_RESPONSE: We received an unexpected response. Try again in a moment.

status.title: System status
status.description: Live health of the Habit Tracker API, checked from your browser.
status.uptime: Up for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Welcome back. Sign in with your email and password.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Start building better habits. It takes less than a minute.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {min, number} characters. A long phrase is easier to remember than a complex word.
signUp.acceptedBody: We've sent a message to {email} with the next step. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder. You can sign in now and confirm your address later.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
validation.summary: {count, plural, one {Fix # field to continue.} other {Fix # fields to continue.}}

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.locked: Too many unsuccessful sign-in attempts. For your security, wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this device. Wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the information you entered is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.resendTooSoon: You've asked for a new link recently. Wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before asking again.

session.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Check your connection and try again.
session.checkFailed: We couldn't check whether you're signed in.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.description: Press the button to confirm that this email address is yours.
verifyEmail.verifiedBody: Thank you. Your email address is verified.
verifyEmail.invalidBody: It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer link. Sign in and ask for a new one.

verifyBanner.title: Confirm your email address
verifyBanner.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to verify your address.
verifyBanner.sent: We've sent a new link. It can take a few minutes to arrive.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the email address of your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If {email} belongs to an account, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for {minutes, number} minutes. If nothing arrives within a few minutes, check your spam folder and that the address is spelled correctly.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account. Changing it signs you out on every device.
resetPassword.doneBody: Your new password is set and every device has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidBody: It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer link. Ask for a new one.
